sources.snippet: What is Abliteration? This model has the "refusal direction" removed from its weights, allowing unrestricted conversations. The abliteration technique projects out the refusal direction from self_attn.o_proj and mlp.down_proj weights across all layers. See douyamv/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated for details. sources.snippet: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is an uncensored version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B created using abliteration, a technique that removes refusal mechanisms from language models without requiring TransformerLens. Developed by huihui-ai, this model retains the first 15 layers without ablation while modifying deeper layers to eliminate safety constraints.
